notes.subject: מפני
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'from the face of the waters of the flood'; Tok Pisin 'long pes bilong' keeps the body-part picture.

notes.subject: teba
notes.rationale: התבה is literally 'box/chest' (same word as baby Moses's basket), rendered as 'teba' the floating box.

notes.subject: bikpela karamap
notes.rationale: המבול with definite article — THE deluge, the one named event, not any flood.

translation: Na Noa i go insait, na ol pikinini man bilong en, na meri bilong en, na ol meri bilong ol pikinini man bilong en, ⟨את⟩ wantaim em, i go long teba, long pes bilong ol wara bilong bikpela karamap.

tokens.gloss: na ol pikinini man bilong en
